StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

BeforeCombatStart.issue: Right slot -- combat.py:356 fires on_combat_start immediately before `start_turn()`, which turn_structure identifies as the sim's BeforeCombatStart. The divergence is an ADDED GUARD (recurring shape 8): C# afflicts EVERY Power card unconditionally (GalvanicPower.cs:34-38 has no `Affliction == null` test at this site, and `CardCmd.Afflict` overwrites) while the sim skips already-afflicted cards (powers.py:3846 `card.affliction is None`). This is the same shape as the already-recorded tangled gap (main report section 4 item 13), where the added test changed the outcome. DORMANT here: at combat start the only other ported BeforeCombatStart afflicter is VitalSparkPower, which afflicts SKILLS -- a disjoint card set -- and no affliction survives across combats. Trigger: a second Power-card afflicter, or a persistent affliction. Also note the sim iterates `combat.player.all_cards` where C# iterates every ALLY player's `PlayerCombatState.AllCards`; single-player equivalent. REVISED 2026-08-04: the old caveat about a Play-pile omission is STALE -- `PlayerCombatState.all_cards` (player.py:184-210) now sweeps `hand + draw_pile + discard_pile + exhaust_pile + play_pile`, Play included as the last leg (player.py:209-210), matching `PlayerCombatState.AllCards`'s Play-last order; there is no longer an omission to be dormant about. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterCardEnteredCombat.rationale: `card.Affliction == null && card.Type == CardType.Power` (GalvanicPower.cs:44) maps exactly to powers.py:3850. This is the site where C# DOES have the null test, which is what makes its absence at BeforeCombatStart deliberate rather than an oversight -- and is why the previous entry is a gap.

AfterCardPlayed.issue: **PROPS.** C# deals the Galvanized damage with `ValueProp.Unpowered | ValueProp.Move` (GalvanicPower.cs:55); the sim passes `DamageProps.NON_CARD_UNPOWERED`, which valueprops.py:42 defines as `UNPOWERED` **alone** -- the MOVE flag is missing. The right constant exists and is one line up: `DamageProps.CARD_UNPOWERED` (valueprops.py:36) is exactly `UNPOWERED | MOVE`. This is the recurring omitted-props shape (main report section 4 item 4) in its damage form. Consequence: cmds.py:350 fires `hooks.on_attacked(...)` only when `ValueProp.MOVE in props`, so in the game this damage counts as a HIT and in the sim it does not -- the pre-block hit event that CurlUp-family powers and Flame Barrier-style reactors listen on. `is_powered_attack` is false either way (UNPOWERED is set on both), so no damage modifier changes. DORMANT: the damage targets the PLAYER and every ported on_attacked implementer is an enemy-side reactor (CurlUp, Skittish), so nothing on the player currently listens. Trigger: any player-side on_attacked listener -- and the fix is a one-word constant change. RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-04 (line numbers only, still NOT fixed at the call site). Third-file citations, not hashed here.
